topic.title: Git Actions in Other Views and Editors
topic.shortdesc: Use Git actions from the Project view, DITA Maps Manager, and the current editor.

body.p: For resources from Git repositories, the Git Client add-on also adds actions to the contextual menus of the Project view, the DITA Maps Manager view, and the current editor in Text or Author mode. These actions include Show history, Show blame, Git Diff (only in the Project view), and Commit (only in the Project view).
If the project folder does not contain a local Git repository, the contextual menu includes the Create repository here action.
